017package org.apache.juneau.petstore.marshall;
018
019import java.awt.image.*;
020import java.io.*;
021
022import javax.imageio.*;
023import javax.imageio.stream.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.marshall.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.marshall.parser.*;
027
028/**
029 * Parses {@code image/png}/{@code image/jpeg}/{@code image/jpg} byte streams into {@link BufferedImage} pet photos.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * Petstore-local port of the deleted {@code juneau-examples-rest} image demo, relocated here (rather than
033 * {@code juneau-examples-core}) so {@code juneau-petstore-core} stays free of any dependency on the examples
034 * modules.  Wired into {@link org.apache.juneau.petstore.rest.PetStoreResource#putPetPhoto(long, BufferedImage)}.
035 *
036 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
037 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/JuneauPetstore">juneau-petstore</a>
038 * </ul>
039 */
040public class PetPhotoParser extends InputStreamParser {
041
042   /** The largest accepted photo, in pixels (width times height). */
043   public static final long MAX_PIXELS = 16L * 1024 * 1024;
044
045   /** The largest accepted photo width or height, in pixels. */
046   public static final int MAX_DIMENSION = 8192;
047
048   /**
049    * Constructor with default settings (consumes image/png, image/jpeg and image/jpg).
050    */
051   public PetPhotoParser() {
052      super(create().consumes("image/png,image/jpeg,image/jpg"));
053   }
054
055   /**
056    * {@inheritDoc}
057    */
058   @Override /* Parser */
059   @SuppressWarnings({
060      "unchecked" // Type erasure requires cast for image return
061   })
062   public <T> T doRead(ParserSession session, ParserPipe pipe, ClassMeta<T> type) throws IOException, ParseException {
063      try (var is = pipe.getInputStream()) {
064         BufferedImage image;
065         try (var iis = ImageIO.createImageInputStream(is)) {
066            image = iis == null ? null : read(session, iis);
067         } catch (IIOException e) {
068            // Corrupt data that looks like a supported image.  Unchecked decoder failures are already wrapped
069            // as ParseException by ParserSession.readInner, so only IIOException needs handling here.
070            throw new ParseException(session, e, "Unsupported or unreadable image data");
071         }
072         if (image == null)
073            throw new ParseException(session, "Unsupported or unreadable image data");
074         return (T)image;
075      }
076   }
077
078   // Reads the declared dimensions from the image header and refuses an oversized image before it is decoded.
079   private static BufferedImage read(ParserSession session, ImageInputStream iis) throws IOException, ParseException {
080      var readers = ImageIO.getImageReaders(iis);
081      if (! readers.hasNext())
082         return null;
083      var reader = readers.next();
084      try {
085         reader.setInput(iis, true, true);
086         long w = reader.getWidth(0), h = reader.getHeight(0);
087         if (w > MAX_DIMENSION || h > MAX_DIMENSION || w * h > MAX_PIXELS)
088            throw new ParseException(session, "Image dimensions exceed the {0} pixel limit", MAX_PIXELS);
089         return reader.read(0);
090      } finally {
091         reader.dispose();
092      }
093   }
094}
